# cloture

> Zero-dependency Rust core (`v0.2.0`), single 2.91 MiB static CLI/MCP binary, C ABI, 243 KB zero-import WebAssembly core, and zero-dependency Python SDK for sub-microsecond anytime-valid multi-agent consensus stopping, correlated-panel auditing, sequential agent racing, active prediction-powered evaluation (Active-PPI++), poisoning-resistant fusion, and 712-byte distributed evidence monoids.

Use `cloture` when building multi-agent swarms, Best-of-N / self-consistency loops, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation panels, online A/B agent benchmarks, or live streaming safety gates where fixed-N sampling wastes 40%–92% of tokens/latency and naive peeking inflates false positives to 28%–54%.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Quickstart, 10-second Python/CLI/MCP examples, and verified head-to-head benchmark tables.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Self-contained full technical reference, API signatures, CLI flags, MCP tools, and verified metrics.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Exact non-asymptotic martingale, Kraft-IUT, Fan-inequality, CRC, and monoid proofs.
- [docs/REAL_WORLD_EVAL.md](docs/REAL_WORLD_EVAL.md): Dual real-world evaluation (strict 5-fold OOS CV) on 2,985 AllenAI RewardBench items (+3.65 pp OOS / +3.85 pp in-sample at -72.7% cost; 80.4% AgentRace savings) and 350 ScalerLab JudgeBench items across 5 labs incl. o1-preview & Claude-3.5-Sonnet (+18.33 pp OOS CV at -76.9% cost; Top-7 cross-family n_eff=2.49/7).
- [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md): Full 7-suite head-to-head benchmark report against confseq, ppi-python, expectation, online-cp, bayesbench, and NumPy/SciPy.
- [docs/comparisons.md](docs/comparisons.md): Factual feature matrix and guidance on when to use cloture vs. alternatives.
- [docs/integrations.md](docs/integrations.md): Copy-paste drop-in recipes for OpenAI/vLLM logprobs, Promptfoo/CSV/JSONL judge-panel audits, Claude Code/Cursor MCP, CI eval gates, and C/WASM FFI.
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Agent skill routing table and statistical integrity rules.
- [server.json](server.json): Official MCP Registry manifest (`io.github.pgg898200-ship-it/cloture`).
- [include/cloture.h](include/cloture.h): Complete C ABI specification.
- [benchmarks/results.json](benchmarks/results.json), [benchmarks/rewardbench_receipts.json](benchmarks/rewardbench_receipts.json), & [benchmarks/judgebench_receipts.json](benchmarks/judgebench_receipts.json): Raw machine-verifiable JSON benchmark receipts.
